name: Pallof Press with Rotation Step
description: A pallof press variation where after pressing out, the athlete takes a step forward or rotates the leading foot, increasing the lever arm and anti-rotation demand. This dynamic element trains core stability through changing base of support. Sport-specific for rotational athletes.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Pallof Press with Rotation Step in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Pallof Press with Rotation Step.
steps: Step 1: Stand sideways to cable with both hands on handle at chest.
Step 2: Press handle straight out from chest to full arm extension.
Step 3: Take a step or rotate leading foot while holding the press.
Step 4: Return hands to chest then step back to start position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Resist the cable's pull on the step
